description: This file defines data structures, enumerations, and function prototypes related to TrueType font tables within the FreeType project. It includes structures for font headers, horizontal and vertical metrics, OS/2, Postscript, PCLT, and maximum profile tables, as well as functions for accessing and loading SFNT tables.

methods.name: FT_Get_Sfnt_Table
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a specific SFNT table within a font face.

methods.name: FT_Load_Sfnt_Table
methods.description: Loads a font table into client memory given its tag and offset.

methods.name: FT_Get_CMap_Language_ID
methods.description: Returns the TrueType/sfnt specific language ID for a character map.
